synthesis.paragraph: In the last 30 days of urban data science publications, Tongji University appeared on 31 papers, Hong Kong Polytechnic University on 25, and both Peking University and the University of Hong Kong on 19. Among recent publications, "Associations of school neighbourhood built environment profiles with active commuting behaviour in Spanish adolescents" shares 6 references with the June 25, 2026 paper "Psychometric properties of the stage of change scales for walking and cycling to school among Spanish children and adolescents", including "Parental barriers to active transport to school: a systematic review" and "Global trends in insufficient physical activity among adolescents: a pooled analysis of 298 population-based surveys with 1·6 million participants". This same paper on Spanish adolescents also shares 4 references with the June 15, 2026 paper "Family support and the built environment as determinants of active school commuting among adolescents in Chile", sharing "Global trends in insufficient physical activity among adolescents: a pooled analysis of 298 population-based surveys with 1·6 million participants" alongside "A systematic review of interventions for promoting active transportation to school" and "Convergent validation of a questionnaire to assess the mode and frequency of commuting to and from school". Additionally, "Trade-linked maritime emissions and ammonia fuel transition in the UAE" shares 4 references with the July 9, 2026 paper "Anticipating China's profound urban shrinkage with a fine-grid perspective in the latter half of the 21st century", with shared citations including "The Shared Socioeconomic Pathways and their energy, land use, and greenhouse gas emissions implications: An overview", "The SSP4: A world of deepening inequality", and "SSP3: AIM implementation of Shared Socioeconomic Pathways".
